steps.name: White Cross (Daisy Method)
steps.description: Form a white cross on the bottom layer while aligning the adjacent edge colors with their matching center pieces.

algorithms.name: Intuitive Edge Alignment
algorithms.condition: Position white edge pieces around yellow center (Daisy) and rotate 180° to white face once side colors match.

steps.name: First Layer Corners
steps.description: Position white corner pieces between their matching color centers in the top layer and insert them into the bottom layer.

algorithms.name: Sexy Move / Corner Insertion
algorithms.condition: Target corner piece is directly above its slot in the top right.

steps.name: Second Layer (Middle Layer Edges)
steps.description: Insert edge pieces without yellow into the middle layer slots (F2L edge insertion).

algorithms.name: Right Edge Insertion
algorithms.condition: The top-front edge piece needs to move into the Front-Right slot.
algorithms.algorithm: U R U' R' U' F' U F

algorithms.name: Left Edge Insertion
algorithms.condition: The top-front edge piece needs to move into the Front-Left slot.
algorithms.algorithm: U' L' U L U F U' F'

steps.name: Yellow Cross (OLL Step 1)
steps.description: Form a yellow cross on the top layer without disturbing the bottom two layers.

algorithms.name: FURU'F' (Fur-U-Ruf)
algorithms.condition: Apply once for horizontal line case, twice for 'L' shape, or three times for a center dot.
algorithms.algorithm: F R U R' U' F'

steps.name: Permute Yellow Edges
steps.description: Align the top edge piece colors with their corresponding side center colors.

algorithms.name: Sune Edge Permutation
algorithms.condition: Swaps the front and left yellow edges so all top edges match side center colors.
algorithms.algorithm: R U R' U R U2 R'

steps.name: Position Yellow Corners (Permute Corners)
steps.description: Move all yellow corner pieces to their correct physical positions (regardless of rotation).

algorithms.name: Niklas / Corner Swap
algorithms.condition: Hold the correctly placed corner on the Front-Right-Top and cycle the remaining 3 corners.
algorithms.algorithm: U R U' L' U R' U' L

steps.name: Orient Yellow Corners
steps.description: Rotate the last layer corners until the yellow faces are facing upwards.

algorithms.name: Reverse Sexy Move
algorithms.condition: Hold unoriented corner in Front-Right-Top spot and repeat until yellow faces UP, then turn top layer (U) to load next unsolved corner.
